title: FancyFreeze
description: A modern freeze plugin with fancy effects and features.
body:
❄️ FancyFreeze ❄️

A modern, fancy freeze plugin, built for Paper with the latest APIs.

FancyFreeze gives your moderation team a powerful and stylish way to freeze suspected cheaters or rule-breakers during investigations. No more barebones, outdated freeze plugins. FancyFreeze is clean, does everything it needs to do, highly configurable, and built entirely on modern Paper APIs. ----------------------------------------------------------------- ## ✨ Key Features: ### 🎇 Visual Effects - **Freeze Effect:** Frozen players get the vanilla freezing visual effect applied to their screen, visually communicating their status. - **Particle Rings:** A lightweight particle ring orbits frozen players so everyone nearby can see what's going on. - **Glow Effect:** Frozen players glow, making them easy for staff to spot from a distance or through walls. ### 🛡️ Moderation - **Comprehensive Freezing:** When a player is frozen, their movement, interactions, inventory usage, and every single action they could do can be completely blocked. - **Command Whitelist:** Block all commands except for the ones you choose (like /msg or /rules). - **Disconnect Penalties:** Run custom console commands automatically if a player leaves the server while frozen. ### 🔧 Configuration - **Modern Formatting:** Fully supports MiniMessage for chat formatting, including hex colors and gradients. - **Fully Configurable:** Every message, toggle, and blocked interaction can be customized in the config to fit your server. ### 🔑 Permissions - **FF.freeze** -> Permission to freeze/unfreeze players. - **FF.freezeall** -> Permission to freeze/unfreeze all players on the server at once. - **FF.bypass** -> Immunity from being frozen. - **FF.reload** -> Permission to reload the plugin's config. - **FF.notify** -> Staff who have this permission are notified when anyone is frozen or unfrozen.
